text:
maria: Heads-up 1: we need a tight benchmark narrative for launch next week. Deliverables: 1 short post, 3-chart mini-deck, short webinar. Focus = latency vs token cost + inbound routing.
emily: Who's our primary audience for the launch? platform engineers or product teams?
raj: Platform engs first. they want p95/p99 and how batching/quantization changes unit economics.
josh: Raw numbers to verify tonight: median gen ~ 88ms, p95 ~ 225ms, p99 ~ 475ms (hosted default). baseline cost ~ $0.235 / 1k tokens. I'll run a fresh job and post exacts.
olga: I'll pull customer slices (hosted vs dedicated). Quick question: headline in $/1k tokens or show a concrete per-request calc?
maria: Headline = $/1k tokens. Also include a worked example for a 500-token response and a normalized per-1k-requests appendix.
emily: Proposed chart set: 1) scatter: latency (x) vs $/1k (y) annotated by model/quant; 2) stacked waterfall: unit cost components Hosted vs Dedicated; 3) heatmap: p99 by sequence length bucket. Keep labels explainer-friendly.
raj: Messaging A/B lines for reg page/social: A) "Predictable latency, transparent unit economics." B) "Keep interactions snappy without burning budget." A = platform tone, B = product tone. We'll test both.
josh: If we show quantized variants add footnote on quality: "avg embedding cosine delta <0.002 on our eval set". Also include test config: model, region, batch policy, and token distro.
benchbot: Figma draft link: https://figma.com/file/redwood/bench-spark-draft (page: "3panel-v2").
maria: Owners & ETA (48h): emily = post + webinar script, raj = charts + figma annotations, josh = validation numbers + appendix, olga = analytics + routing rules.
olga: Setting up GA + Segment events and adding hidden reg fields: `priority_latency` and `priority_cost`.
maria: Inbound routing rules for SDRs: - if "priority_latency" AND p99 requirement > 300ms => tag "dedicated-sales"; - if high spend (top decile) => tag "cost-review"; - else => standard nurture. Add these as radio/checkbox options in reg form.
emily: Webinar format: 20 min talk, 10 min Q&A, demo of two quick use cases, CTA = book demo or claim hosted credits.
raj: Add anonymized customer vignette slide comparing before/after latency & cost. Good signal for buyers.
josh: Example math for the post: 500-token response at $0.235/1k => $0.1175 per response. Also show cost per 1k requests for a 200-token avg prompt. I'll post the exact calc.
maria: Copy targets: post 300-420 words, deck <=5 slides, social snippets 1-line + 1 variant, webinar dry-run 48h before.
benchbot: Reminder: ping #eng-runtime before publish to capture an infra snapshot for the appendix.
emily: I'll draft everything and upload slide text in 36h.
raj: I'll upload chart PNGs & annotations in 36h.
josh: Fresh numbers by tomorrow morning.
olga: Funnel doc when ready.
maria: Keep claims conservative, show test configs, include worked example, and add routing tags on reg form. Great work team :rocket:.
